Messages.Author: Nac
Messages.Body:
Hi

1) is there a timing window for warsaw station to burn when Amaranth is played? we were confused about it as Amaranth is an instead and we're not that sure how replacement effects work in Vtes

2) Vamp A play Alpha glint, impulse goes to me so I play Illusions of the kindred. Both resolve, combat ends and Illusion combat starts. is that correct?

Many thanks in advance

Warsaw Station

Unique location.
You can lock this card as a Nosferatu announces an undirected action; after action resolution, if that action was successful, unlock the acting Nosferatu. You can burn this card (even if it is locked) to move a Nosferatu in torpor to the ready region.

Amaranth

Only usable by a vampire who can commit diablerie. Only usable when the opposing vampire should go to torpor. Diablerize the opposing vampire instead. Not usable by a vampire being burned or going to torpor.

Alpha Glint

Not usable in combat with an ally or an older vampire.
AnimalismFortitude Strike: combat ends.
Superior AnimalismSuperior Fortitude Only usable before range is determined. Combat ends.

Illusions of the Kindred

Only usable before range is determined.
Chimerstry Combat ends. Move the bottom card from your crypt to your ready region. That minion does not contest any other minions or titles in play. That vampire gains blood equal to half their capacity rounded down. That vampire and the opposing minion enter combat. Remove that minion from the game at the end of combat (if they are still in play).
Superior Chimerstry As above, but that vampire gains blood equal to their capacity.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Nac wrote:
>
> 1) is there a timing window for warsaw station to burn when Amaranth is played? we were confused about it as Amaranth is an instead and we're not that sure how replacement effects work in Vtes
>
The vampire doesn't go to torpor. "Instead", the vampire is diablerized. You cannot use Warsaw Station since it requires the vampire to be in torpor.

> Nac wrote:
> 2) Vamp A play Alpha glint, impulse goes to me so I play Illusions of the kindred. Both resolve, combat ends and Illusion combat starts. is that correct?
>
No. Alpha Glint ends the combat, so you cannot play Illusions of the Kindred afterwards.
